summary: Independent review of the HEK293 half of PXD031395 (6 anti-HA co-IP runs on Q Exactive HF: control, HA::AdipoR2, HA::AdipoR2 + palmitic acid; two rounds) found no blocker or important issues. Runs, conditions, instrument, fragmentation, search tolerances, reagents and modifications all trace to RAW headers, deposited .msf names, the PRIDE protocols and the JBC 2023 paper. Only minor omissions and provenance points remain.

reviewer_context.context: fresh reviewer agent without producer transcript; producer report.md and evidence.json treated as untrusted; only scratchpad/PXD031395/ evidence read (identity asserted: pride.json accession PXD031395, all file URLs under /PXD031395/, manuscript PMID 37164154 = PRIDE reference)

spec_compliance.evidence: 6 data rows x 41 columns, uniform field count, no CR/leading/trailing whitespace; templates ms-proteomics + human + cell-lines v1.1.0 independently derived as correct for HEK293 (cell-lines requires a technology and sample layer; human is the sample layer). All required human columns (disease, age, sex) and cell-lines columns (cell line, disease, cellosaurus accession) present; source names and assay names unique; collision energy '28% NCE' matches spec pattern/example; reserved words used correctly.

ontology_integrity.evidence: Resolved in offline cache: MS:1002523 Q Exactive HF, MS:1001251 Trypsin, MS:1000422 beam-type collision-induced dissociation, PRIDE:0000627 data-dependent acquisition, PRIDE:0000608 DTT, PRIDE:0000605 MMTS, UNIMOD:39 Methylthio (correct for MMTS on C), UNIMOD:35 Oxidation; labels Homo sapiens (NCBITaxon:9606), kidney (UBERON:0002113), normal (PATO:0000461), female (PATO:0000383), cell line, HEK293 (CLO/EFO), palmitic acid (NCIT:C61873). 'untreated' not in cache but is the spec's own example value for characteristics[treatment]. CVCL_0045 = HEK293 per saved Cellosaurus record.

source_evidence.evidence: RAW headers: all 6 files model 'Q Exactive HF - Orbitrap MS', DD-MS, NCE 28, 60-min method (matches HEK293 60-min gradient in PRIDE protocol). Sample names '3234 IP ctl / IP R2-HA / IP R2-HA PA' (190823_02/05/08) and msf '3256_ctl / R2-HA / R2-HA-PA_*_190911_38/41/44' fix the condition per run. PA = palmitic acid per paper abbreviation and 'HEK293 fatty acid treatment' section; corroborated by paper 'at least 2/4 HA::AdipoR2 IPs in HEK293 cells' (4 = 2 untreated + 2 PA). Controls = 'cells that do not express HA-tagged proteins'. Tolerances 5 ppm / 30 mmu (0.03 Da) for human, DTT, MMTS, trypsin, S-Trap, Met oxidation variable, Cys alkylation static: PRIDE protocols. Sex female, disease none: Cellosaurus CVCL_0045.

file_mapping.evidence: 6 comment[data file] values = exactly the 6 QEHF_1908*/1909* RAW files in files_compact.json; the other 6 RAW (QEHF_1805*, Fusion_*) are all in PXD031395-celegans.sdrf.tsv; 12/12 RAW covered once across the split, no overlap, no non-RAW files referenced.

design_consistency.evidence: 3 conditions x 2 rounds (3234 = Rd.1 on 2019-08-23, 3256 = Rd.2 on 2019-09-11) = 6 independent IPs; biological replicate 1/2 per condition, technical replicate 1, fraction 1, label free. factor value[genotype] and [treatment] equal their characteristics columns; bait column consistent with genotype. Round is perfectly balanced across conditions (no confounding).

omission_safety.evidence: No value asserts more than evidence: PA dose/duration deliberately omitted (IP methods do not state it); age/developmental stage/cell type left 'not available'; ancestry omitted. Supported but omitted optional/recommended metadata recorded as minor findings (culture medium, biorepository, fetal origin).

deterministic_validation.evidence: flock /tmp/sdrf_validate.lock parse_sdrf validate-sdrf -s annotations/PXD031395-hek293.sdrf.tsv -t ms-proteomics -t human -t cell-lines --use_ols_cache_only -> exit 0, one warning ('untreated' not in ncit/efo). sdrf-tools check --offline -> CLEAN, exit 0. sdrf-tools structure -> OK, exit 0. sdrf-tools score -> 99/100 (only missing recommended ancestry category), exit 0.

findings.message: Supported cell-culture metadata is not annotated: characteristics[culture medium] and characteristics[biorepository].
findings.evidence: manuscript 'HEK293 cell maintenance': 'obtained from the American Type Culture Collection and grown in Dulbecco's modified Eagle's medium ... 10% fetal bovine serum'.
findings.correction: Optionally add characteristics[culture medium]=DMEM (with FBS) and characteristics[biorepository]=ATCC.

findings.message: Donor developmental stage is 'not available' although the saved Cellosaurus record gives AG 'Fetus'.
findings.correction: Optionally set developmental stage to a fetal-stage term (or leave as is).

findings.message: 'wild type' presumes parental untransfected HEK293; the paper only states controls are cells 'that do not express HA-tagged proteins' (could be parental or empty-vector).
findings.evidence: manuscript Results; RAW name '3234 IP ctl'; msf '*_ctl_*'.
findings.correction: Acceptable; optionally note in limitations or use a more neutral label such as 'no HA-tagged transgene'.

findings.message: Tag position is reported inconsistently in the paper (Results 'HA::AdipoR2', Methods 'AdipoR2-HA', construct 'pIREShyg2-HA-hAdipoR2-cMYC', i.e. N-terminal HA plus C-terminal MYC); 'HA::AdipoR2' follows Results and construct name and is defensible.
findings.evidence: manuscript Results, IP Methods, plasmids section.
findings.correction: None required; optionally mention the C-terminal MYC tag in limitations.

findings.message: Manifest 'artifact' field names the C. elegans SDRF; this artifact appears only under 'additional_artifacts'. No sex/organism-part claim cites Cellosaurus explicitly.
findings.correction: Optionally provide a per-artifact manifest or list both artifacts explicitly, and add claims for cell-line characteristics.
